_comment: How bad a dig gets. base is the first chamber; per_depth is added (or for spacing and breath, subtracted) for every chamber deeper. Curves rather than a table per depth, so the twentieth dig is worse than the nineteenth without anyone authoring the nineteenth. growth is what turns a trickle into a swarm: each wave is this many times the last, so the first is a handful and the last is a tide. ant is the creature itself -- health and touch damage are balance, not code. surge is the surfacing burst: each creature erupts OUT of the hole in its own direction before it starts hunting, so a held spray at the pit mouth meets a scattering ring rather than a queue.
